items.title: Hardcore History's Dan Carlin On Video Games And War Remains
items.description: In this excerpt from The Game Informer Show podcast, Ben Hanson interviews Hardcore History's Dan Carlin about his favorite video games and creating the World War 1 VR installation called War Remains that is opening in Austin on August 12th.
